Alloy Wheel Wraps

Alloy Wheel Wraps can be a great way to refresh their look, improve their condition, or even completely change their style. Here's what you need to know about alloy wheel liquid wrapping.

The Process:

Preparation is key: Professional alloy wheel wraps involves thoroughly cleaning the wheels to remove dirt, grease, and any loose paint. This is followed by sanding the surface to create a good key for the new paint to adhere to.

Stripping vs. Painting over: In some cases, the existing paint may need to be completely stripped off, especially if it's damaged or flaking.

Painting: Several coats of high-quality paint designed specifically for wheels are applied. This is usually followed by a clear coat for added protection and shine.

Benefits of a alloy wheel wraps

  1. Customization: Alloy wheel wraps allows for virtually unlimited customization options, including a wide range of colors, finishes, and effects. Whether you want a matte, glossy, metallic, or even a colour-shifting finish, plasti dip can help you achieve the look you desire.
  2. Temporary: Unlike permanent paint or powder coating, plasti dip provides a temporary color change that can be easily removed when desired. This makes it an ideal option for individuals who like to change the appearance of their wheels frequently or want to try out different colours without commitment.
  3. Protection: Liquid wrap forms a flexible and durable rubber coating that can protect the wheels from scratches, chips, and road debris. It acts as a barrier against environmental elements, including UV rays, salt, and moisture, helping to preserve the original finish of the wheels.
  4. Cost-Effective: Alloy wheel wraps is generally more affordable than traditional paint or powder coating, making it a cost-effective option for customizing alloy wheels. It eliminates the need for expensive equipment or professional services, allowing enthusiasts to achieve professional-looking results at a fraction of the cost.
  5. DIY-Friendly: Applying liquid wrap to alloy wheels can be a fun and rewarding do-it-yourself project for enthusiasts. With proper preparation and application techniques, individuals can achieve professional-looking results at home without the need for specialized skills or equipment.
  6. Reversibility: One of the most significant benefits of liquid wrap is its reversibility. If you decide you no longer like the color or finish of your wheels, or if you want to return them to their original appearance for resale or trade-in purposes, plasti dip can be easily peeled off without damaging the underlying surface.
  7. Versatility: Alloy wheel wraps can be used on a variety of surfaces, including alloy wheels, plastic trim, emblems, and even entire vehicles. This versatility allows for endless creative possibilities and customization options for vehicle enthusiasts.

DIY vs. Professional:

DIY is possible: DIY alloy wheel respray kits are available, but it's a time-consuming and somewhat tricky process.

Benefits of a professional: We have all the latest equipment and fully trained to carry out your liquid wrapped alloy wheels. Our team have the latest equipment, experience, and paint materials to ensure a durable, high-quality finish that will last. We can also offer a wider variety of paint options, including custom colours.

Additional Considerations:

Cost: Professional respraying is generally more expensive than a DIY approach, but the cost varies depending on the size of the wheels, the complexity of the design, and the number of paint coats applied.

Downtime: We will require your wheels for a few days to ensure that we carry out the professional finish you are looking for.

Using only the best materials from Matt-Pack, you can rest assured your graphics will last for years.
